d:
Details 
 A western dress shirt distinguished by symmetric damask embroidery with piping-outlined borders — heraldic in structure, the damask pattern is anchored by reinforced cordoncillo piping that frames the design with precision, giving this shirt a formal, architectural character that sets it apart from more fluid embroidery styles.
 Made from a modern fit stretch cotton/spandex blend — the symmetric damask composition on the western yoke references traditional heraldry and decorative tile-work, with the piping borders delivering a level of structural definition that makes every motif read with clarity.
 The premium embroidered western shirt for formal events, galas, or any occasion that calls for maximum artisanal detail and a dress shirt with genuine heraldic character.
 Key Features:
- Modern fit stretch cotton/spandex blend
- Point collar with snap button closure
- Western yoke with pointed shoulders
- Dual chest pockets with snap flaps
- Long sleeve
- Machine washable
- Symmetric damask embroidery pattern on western yoke
- Cordoncillo piping borders for precise structural definition
- Heraldic composition with formal architectural symmetry
